data.title: First reminder: Muster Magazin subscription
data.summary: Muster Verlag GmbH sent a first reminder (1. Mahnung) for the unpaid annual fee of the "Muster Magazin" subscription. The total due is €61.90, to be paid by 30 June 2025.
data.explanation: The publisher says your annual subscription fee of €59.40 is still unpaid and has added a reminder fee of €2.50. Please transfer €61.90 to the account named in the letter by 30 June 2025. If you have already paid, you can disregard the letter, as it states. If you think the claim is wrong, contact the publisher's customer service. Check that the IBAN and sender details match your subscription before paying.
